Architectural_Finding: Under peripheral edge gateway monitoring where flows sample standard network endpoints (R approx 0.42), batch mean risk never reaches 0.75 (Z = 41.25 sigma, 0 batches in L5). However, when evaluating traffic routed through designated core backbone SDN hub switches (R >= 0.75), all 1,000 batches (100,000 flows) escalate decisively into Level L5 (Critical Hub Containment), populating the sixth posture tier.
